working_definition: Olfactory projection neuron type VA1v (Xie et al. 2021) at 0 h or 24 h APF.
searches_performed: immature antennal lobe projection neuron VA1v

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any antennal lobe projection neuron (FBbt:00007422) that develops from some neuroblast BAmv3 (FBbt:00067346).

justification: Up to the pupal stage the immature term is used (curator), but FBbt has no immature (or remodelling) antennal lobe projection neuron terms yet (requested, curator 2026-10-17); meanwhile the stage-neutral class for the authors' lineage (adPN), to be refined when the new terms exist. Lineage: the authors' per-cell `lineage` for this type in the main analysis: adPN 157, unlabelled 5. kn+ PNs (knot analysis, no lineage column): the paper states they "include six types of adPNs and two vPNs" (Figure 2), i.e. D, DM6, VA1v, VM2, VM7, VM5v (adPN) and the two vPNs.
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00067349 antennal lobe projection neuron adPN (broad match) until FBbt has the immature / remodelling term for VA1v.
